title: Dry Skin from AC Office Air: A Simple Morning, Desk and Night Routine
ex: Why air conditioning dries out skin, and a simple morning, desk and night routine for working days in a cold office, plus habits that help.
rt: Dry Skin from AC Office: A Simple Daily Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Dry skin from AC office air: why it happens, a simple morning, desk and night routine, the right moisturiser texture by skin type, and habits that help.
quick: AC pulls moisture out of the air, and dry air pulls water out of skin all day. Use a slightly richer moisturiser before work, top up dry areas with a small cream at lunch, drink water, sit away from vents, and use a nourishing night cream, especially if you sleep with AC on.
facts: Air conditioning lowers humidity as it cools a room.
Even oily skin can become dehydrated in AC.
Plain water mist evaporates; seal it with cream.
Sleeping with AC on keeps drying skin overnight.
